label: Placebo
rationale: This is an interventional randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with a dedicated placebo arm. The placebo is a matching oral tablet given alongside riluzole during the 30-week blinded phase, and all participants later receive colchicine in the open-label extension.

evidence.quote: Matching placebo oral tablets identical in appearance

title: Colchicine Effect on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Patients
